candidate_rule: E5-C58: selected parents preceding child by 1..90 timestamps with one of three host links

denominators.event_recall: selected malicious events / all malicious events
denominators.alert_edge_recall: both endpoints alerted / all truth edges
denominators.candidate_recall_given_alerts: true parent in candidate set / both endpoints alerted truth edges
denominators.top1_given_candidates: true parent ranked first / true parent in candidate set
denominators.top3_given_candidates: true parent ranked in first 3 / true parent in candidate set

limitations: Matched-signal perturbation uses benign ground-truth labels to form counterfactual distribution
Top-k candidate diagnostics use ranker decision function, not gate probabilities
Frozen gate calibration differs between rerankers
All budgets evaluated on test: diagnostic grid, not model selection
Candidate search depends on alerts for both endpoints
